read_dataframe: read a CSV file into a pandas DataFrame with automatic column type conversion and sorting
batchify_function: batchify a function for efficient GPU processing with configurable batch size and progress tracking
efficient_batchify_dataframe: efficiently batchify a function for processing a DataFrame grouped by column values
unroll_batched_outputs: unroll batched outputs back to match the original DataFrame row indices
aggregate_batched_results: aggregate batched results by concatenating tensors or flattening lists and dicts
